headline: Mexican Equities Edge Up 0.3% Following Unexpected Banxico Rate Cut
summary: Mexico's stock market edged up 0.3% as Banxico surprised markets with a rate cut, causing the peso to slip while Wall Street declined.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions directly influence domestic currency valuations and local equity market sentiment, providing key signals for regional investors.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: A surprise rate cut typically weakens the domestic currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An unexpected interest rate reduction by Banxico lowered borrowing costs, supporting equities while weakening the Mexican peso against the US dollar.
